fusions.name: Lazy Flick
fusions.desc: An unhurried lash deals 5 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Wide Wake
fusions.desc: A long, wide sweep deals 26 damage to everything in a cone 6 tiles ahead, and on a hit every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Everything Drifts
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Blubber Buffer
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
